checks.name: Spec immutability and completeness
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path /home/infra-sj278/automonique/rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test sandbox spec_completeness; then rustc compile probes assigning to spec.tenant and calling ten spec accessors named by the contract
checks.output: Immutability holds and is measured: `spec.tenant = "globex".to_owned()` fails to compile with E0616 "field tenant of struct SandboxSpec is private", and the type exposes no setter. Completeness does not hold. The contract's field list names roughly 16 groups; SandboxSpecParts carries 9 (profile identity+version, policy digest, tenant, workspace context, the two egress policies, required features, budgets, prohibited capabilities). A compile probe naming the contract's other fields produced 10 E0599 errors on SandboxSpec: actor, provider_account, workspace_context (stored but with no accessor), base_revision, path_grants, tool_allowlist, credential_descriptors, nested_isolation, approval_revision, enforcement_implementation_digests. So actor, provider account, immutable base revision, readable/writable path grants, executable/interpreter/tool/MCP/companion allowlists, credential descriptors with their permitted process class, accepted enforcement implementation digests, nested isolation requirements and the approval/policy revision are all absent; the workspace security context is a plain bounded string rather than a hash. There is also no coverage table against the requirement anywhere in the crate or its tests, which the row requires by name. The two tests that do run assert 8 fields and one empty-field rejection (category field_invalid).

checks.name: No silent downgrade
checks.output: 2 tests pass. A spec requiring [cgroup_v2, landlock_abi_3] admitted on a host offering only cgroup_v2 fails with SandboxError::RequiredEnforcementMissing{feature:"landlock_abi_3"} — the feature is named. Negotiation is exhausted over the two-feature power set: all three incomplete host sets ([], [cgroup_v2], [landlock_abi_3]) refuse with category required_enforcement_missing and the complete set admits. admit_on returns Result<(), SandboxError>, so its success type carries no profile at all and there is no value in which a weaker resolution could be returned.

checks.name: Attestation comparison
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path /home/infra-sj278/automonique/rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test sandbox attestation_comparison; then rustc compile probe calling attestation accessors named by the contract
checks.reason: The clause "quarantined permitting only observation, reconciliation or cancellation" has no representation in this layer, so no command could exercise it.
checks.output: Measured and passing: 2 tests cover all five adoption cases. adopt_host(Some(a), Some(a)) = Adopted; a differing seccomp digest, Some/None, None/Some and None/None all = Quarantined. Adoption is a comparison of the recorded value against the observed one (`recorded == observed` over all six fields), never a reconstruction — there is no constructor path from an observation to an adopted state. Not measured: AdoptionOutcome::Quarantined is a bare enum variant with no associated permitted-operation set, and nothing in the crate or its tests expresses or checks that only observation, reconciliation or cancellation are allowed; the restriction exists solely as a doc comment. Also recorded: EnforcementAttestation carries 6 of the roughly 12 fields the contract lists and has no accessors at all — resolved_paths, process_group, credential_delivery_mode and landlock_abi all fail with E0599.

checks.name: Narrowing-only reuse
checks.output: 5 tests pass. Identical and narrower requests return ReuseOutcome::Reuse. Wider, incomparable, a different tenant, and a widened provider-control egress (BrokeredNamed -> BrokeredAny with an otherwise identical profile) all return ReuseOutcome::RequiresNewHost. evaluate_reuse takes two &SandboxSpec and returns an enum, so it has no path that mutates either spec in place.

checks.name: Budget typing
checks.output: 2 budget tests plus the distinctness test pass. Budget::new takes a BudgetUnit by value, so a unitless budget has no constructor. All four units (milliseconds, memory_bytes, processes, temp_bytes) accept exactly their ceiling (86400000, 68719476736, 4096, 549755813888) and reject ceiling+1 with category budget_out_of_range and a message naming the unit. Exhaustion and violation are distinct: ViolationClass::BudgetExhaustion != PolicyViolation and their dispositions differ (terminate_run_and_record vs terminate_run). Recorded gap that belongs to the completeness row rather than this one: the contract's budget list names cgroup, rlimit, timeout, temporary storage, spool and artifact budgets, and only four units exist.

checks.name: Violation dispositions
checks.output: 4 tests pass. ViolationClass::ALL has exactly the 4 contract classes (policy_violation, budget_exhaustion, enforcement_loss, attestation_mismatch), each has a disposition, all four spellings are distinct, and every disposition is one of TerminateRun, TerminateRunAndRecord or Quarantine. The Disposition enum has exactly three variants and no Continue, so "continue" is unrepresentable rather than merely unused. EnforcementLoss and AttestationMismatch both map to Quarantine.
